t: A stand-up asks your team a few short questions on chosen days. Everyone answers when it suits them.
In this video, you will learn how to answer a stand-up, read the team roll-up and blockers, and set a stand-up up.
Click Work in the left menu, then Stand-up.
On the left are your stand-ups for today, with your answers.
At the stand-up's time you get a reminder. Press Change to answer or update.
Answer the questions. If something is stopping you, turn on I'm blocked: your manager and the organiser are told. Then press Save.
On the right, the roll-up shows how many answered, blockers first, then everyone's answers.
Use the arrows to see other days, and the tabs to switch stand-ups.
Admins and department heads press New: give it a name, choose who, the time and days, and up to three questions.
Next in the Work menu: Approvals.
